hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

runtime.engine: vLLM with the checkpoint's glm52_vision plugin

quantizationDisclosure.textBackbone: hybrid MXFP8 + NVFP4 + NF3; full 753B model with all 256 experts
quantizationDisclosure.vision: MoonViT vision tower and trained PatchMerger inherited from the Baseten GLM-5.2-Vision release

run.cleanup: The benchmark Pod was stopped and deleted after the result was saved; its 500 GB volume was also removed.

notes: The publisher's prebuilt GHCR vision image rejected anonymous pulls during this run.
The public base runtime was used and the small vision plugin was installed from the checkpoint repository before serving.
This is not a result for Baseten's official pure-NVFP4 deployment and must be labeled as the community hybrid checkpoint.
